suggestions.roleTitle: Quality Control and Sustainable Garment Inspector
suggestions.roleTitleVi: Kiểm định viên Chất lượng và May mặc Bền vững
suggestions.reasoning: According to the World Economic Forum (WEF) Future of Jobs Report, Southeast Asia faces significant manufacturing and technology transitions where sustainability and quality assurance roles are rising priorities amidst shifting industrial skill requirements.
suggestions.whyItFitsYou: Your 8 years of experience in garment manufacturing, technical drawing literacy, and precision inspection perfectly match the physical and quality oversight demands of high-end manufacturing. It leverages your manual strengths without requiring heavy digital mastery initially.

evidenceCitations.paperTitle: The Future of Jobs Report 2023 & 2025 Outlook
evidenceCitations.quoteOrDataPoint: By 2027, 44% of workers' skills will be disrupted, with sustainability specialists and quality-oriented production roles gaining strategic importance in transition zones.

trajectories.pathTitle: Senior Quality Inspector with Digital Tools
trajectories.pathTitleVi: Kiểm định viên chất lượng cao cấp ứng dụng số
trajectories.shortDescription: Enhance current garment inspection skills with basic digital reporting tools to secure senior floor roles.
trajectories.rationale: Leverages your deep manufacturing experience while gently introducing digital reporting capabilities.
trajectories.actionStepNow: Start basic computer literacy practice using free online tutorials for 6 hours per week.

trajectories.pathTitleVi: Kinh doanh nhỏ sản phẩm may thủ công bền vững
trajectories.shortDescription: Leverage your handcraft interest and garment skills to start a small independent tailoring or upcycled craft service.
trajectories.rationale: Aligns with your personal interest in small business and handcrafts, operating well within your budget constraints.
trajectories.actionStepNow: Explore local artisan groups and outline a small product line focusing on upcycled garments.

trajectories.pathTitleVi: Chuyên viên công nghệ may tự động
trajectories.shortDescription: Transition into programming and monitoring automated cutting and sewing machinery.
trajectories.rationale: High hurdle due to limited English and digital background, but offers strong long-term industrial relevance.
trajectories.actionStepNow: Familiarize yourself with computer basics before attempting machinery software interfaces.
